stories.title: College offering guidance to Flintshire pupils after GCSE results
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria staff are available on Thursday for pupils who are unsure about their GCSE results or their next step. Lecturers, advisors and admissions staff are on hand at the college’s sites in Deeside, Wrexham, Northop and Llysfasi. The advice covers A Levels, apprenticeships and vocational training. stories.summary: Pupils at Hawarden High School collected their GCSE results on Thursday, with more than three quarters gaining at least five qualifications at grades A* to C or equivalent. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s Streetscene and Transportation Department says operational and resource pressures are responsible for a number of missed bin collections around the county.
